layout.design_note: full-resolution typography, contrast tested at 390 px; exact overlays separate from scene raster

lighting_and_camera.camera: sweeping epic high-angle travel line toward seven symbolic sunlit gateways, full-bleed landscape montage, 9:16 cinematic scale

lighting.key: low distant golden horizon; sun appears from behind seven symbolic gateways
lighting.fill: cool sky and subtle earth-bounce foreground
lighting.rim: natural warm edge only on distant terrain
lighting.air: regional haze with separately legible biome silhouettes, no new roads implied
lighting.text_safe: upper center low-detail open sky; low glow behind text
lighting.forbidden: new permanent shrine or gate, false geography, overexposed headline
lighting.light_consistency_qa: Each subject must be legible in grayscale with plausible source, fill, rim, atmosphere; typography overlays deterministic; actual full-resolution generated-image QA required.

image_generation_policy.background: canon-safe cinematic scenes and motivated lighting
image_generation_policy.forbidden_in_generated_raster: No generated team names, record numbers, source percentages or readable copy
image_generation_policy.exact_overlay: Separate deterministic typography pass after rendering
image_generation_policy.must_preserve_identity: each canonical character crop SHA and Atlas structural plate
